summary_zh: 本页标题为“暗度陈仓”，配图是一位手持长矛、低头前行的古代士兵，暗示即将展开秘密军事行动。

page_text_ocr_zh: 韩信是汉朝著名的军事家。可是，他刚投奔汉王刘邦的时候，刘邦根本没看出他有什么特别的才能，只让他做了个管粮食的小官。丞相萧何跟韩信见过几次面，认定韩信是个奇才，多次举荐他，但刘邦一直没有理会。
page_text_en: Han Xin was a famous military strategist of the Han Dynasty. However, when he first joined King Liu Bang, Liu Bang didn't see any special talent in him and only appointed him as a minor official in charge of grain. Chancellor Xiao He had met Han Xin several times, recognized him as a genius, and recommended him many times, but Liu Bang never paid attention.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了韩信初投刘邦时未被重用，仅任管粮小官，而丞相萧何多次举荐他，但刘邦始终未予理会。

page_text_ocr_zh: 刘邦那时刚被项羽封为汉王，都城在南郑。南郑的南边是连绵不断的巴山，北边是高大陡峭的秦岭。被困在这个山沟沟里，刘邦再想争夺天下可就难了。军中的将士们都很失望，前前后后逃走了几十个。
page_text_en: At that time, Liu Bang had just been appointed by Xiang Yu as the King of Han, with his capital in Nanzheng. To the south of Nanzheng lay the continuous Bashan Mountains, and to the north, the tall and steep Qinling Mountains. Trapped in this mountain valley, it would be difficult for Liu Bang to compete for the empire. The soldiers in the army were very discouraged, and dozens of them had fled one after another.
summary_zh: 本页描述了刘邦被封为汉王后，因都城南郑地处险要、被群山环绕，导致军队士气低落，许多将士纷纷逃走的困境。

page_text_ocr_zh: 韩信知道萧何多次把他举荐给刘邦，刘邦却始终没有召见他。他认为自己在刘邦这里得不到重用，于是也悄悄地逃走了。萧何听说韩信跑了，来不及跟手下的人说一声，就丢下公文追了出去。
page_text_en: Han Xin knew that Xiao He had recommended him to Liu Bang many times, but Liu Bang had never summoned him. He believed he was not being properly utilized by Liu Bang, so he secretly fled. When Xiao He heard that Han Xin had run away, he didn't even have time to tell his subordinates and immediately left his official documents behind to chase after him.
summary_zh: 韩信因未被刘邦重用而选择逃走，萧何得知后立即丢下公文追了出去。

page_text_ocr_zh:
"大王，不好了，萧丞相逃走了！"刘邦听到这个消息很难过。
没想到过了两天，萧何竟然回来了，还带回来一个人。刘邦又惊又喜，急忙出门迎接萧何。见了面，他一把拉住萧何的手，大声问道："你为什么要逃跑呀？"萧何赶紧解释道："我没有逃跑，我是去追逃跑的人！"
page_text_en:
"Your Majesty, bad news! Chancellor Xiao has run away!" Liu Bang was very distressed upon hearing this news.
Unexpectedly, after two days, Xiao He returned, bringing back a person with him. Liu Bang was both surprised and delighted, and hurried out to greet Xiao He. Upon meeting, he grabbed Xiao He's hand and asked loudly: "Why did you run away?" Xiao He quickly explained: "I didn't run away; I went to chase after someone who ran away!"
summary_zh: 刘邦得知萧何逃走后十分难过，两天后萧何返回并带回一人，刘邦惊喜迎接，萧何解释自己是去追逃走的人。

page_text_ocr_zh: 刘邦好奇地问：‘你追的是谁？’萧何回答说：‘韩信！’刘邦更觉得奇怪了：‘逃跑的将领那么多，你一个都没有去追过，为什么单单要把这韩信追回来？’
page_text_en: Liu Bang curiously asked, 'Who did you chase?' Xiao He replied, 'Han Xin!' Liu Bang was even more puzzled: 'So many generals have fled, yet you didn't go after any of them. Why did you single out Han Xin to chase back?'
summary_zh: 刘邦对萧何追回韩信感到疑惑，质问为何只追韩信而不追其他逃跑的将领。

page_text_ocr_zh:
萧何把韩信拉到身边，郑重地说：‘那些将领容易得到，不必追。但像韩信这样杰出的人才，天下再也找不出第二个！大王如果只想做个汉王，自然用不着韩信。但大王如果想争夺天下，就只有韩信能帮您了！’
‘好，我相信你的眼光，就封韩信为将军吧！’刘邦说。
page_text_en:
Xiao He pulled Han Xin closer and said solemnly: 'Those generals are easy to find; there's no need to chase after them. But someone as outstanding as Han Xin—there is no second such person in the world! If Your Majesty only wishes to be the King of Han, then Han Xin is not needed. But if Your Majesty wishes to conquer the entire realm, then only Han Xin can help you!' 
'Alright, I trust your judgment. I will appoint Han Xin as General!' said Liu Bang.
summary_zh: 萧何向刘邦力荐韩信，强调其不可替代的才能，刘邦最终被说服，决定封韩信为将军。

page_text_ocr_zh:
安顿完韩信，萧何又找到刘邦对他说：“大王，只是当将军，韩信不一定能留得住呀！”
“那就封他为大将军！”刘邦马上传令下去，给韩信加封大将军。
page_text_en:
After settling Han Xin, Xiao He found Liu Bang and said to him: "Your Majesty, if he is only made a general, Han Xin may not stay!"
"Then make him the Grand General!" Liu Bang immediately gave the order to bestow the title of Grand General upon Han Xin.
summary_zh: 萧何向刘邦建议必须重用韩信，否则他可能离开；刘邦听从建议，立即封韩信为大将军。

page_text_ocr_zh: 韩信当了大将军后，对刘邦说：“要想争夺天下，首先要平定三秦，夺得关中。”刘邦却很担心：“关中与南郑中间隔着秦岭，只有一条栈道相通。而且我率军来南郑的时候，已经把那栈道烧了，我们怎么过得去呢？”韩信悄悄地把自己的计策告诉了刘邦，胸有成竹地说：“只要大王相信我，把军队交给我指挥，不出五个月，一定能得到关中。”
page_text_en: After Han Xin became the Grand General, he told Liu Bang: "To compete for the world, we must first pacify the Three Qins and seize Guanzhong." Liu Bang was very worried: "Between Guanzhong and Nanzheng lies the Qinling Mountains, connected only by a single mountain path. Moreover, when I led my army to Nanzheng, I had already burned that path. How can we possibly get through?" Han Xin secretly revealed his plan to Liu Bang and said confidently: "As long as Your Majesty trusts me and entrusts me with command of the army, within five months, we will surely capture Guanzhong."
summary_zh: 韩信被封为大将军后，向刘邦提出夺取关中的战略，并自信地保证只要交给他指挥，不出五个月必能成功，而刘邦对此表示担忧，因通往关中的栈道已被烧毁。

page_text_ocr_zh: 刘邦听了韩信的计策，真的把军队交给了他。韩信先调配将士，编排队伍，操练兵马，宣布纪律，没过多长时间，就把军队训练得威武雄壮。然后，他又派一万名士兵去修栈道。可是，栈道真的很难修呀！
page_text_en: Liu Bang, after hearing Han Xin's strategy, truly handed over the army to him. Han Xin first assigned soldiers, organized the ranks, trained the troops, and announced discipline. In no time, he had trained the army to be mighty and formidable. Then, he sent ten thousand soldiers to repair the mountain pass. But, repairing the pass was really difficult!
summary_zh: 韩信被任命为大将军后，开始整顿军队并派兵修缮被烧毁的栈道，但修道过程十分艰难。

page_text_ocr_zh: 上面是悬崖峭壁，下面是滚滚波涛，士兵一不小心掉下去，连声"救命"都来不及喊，就被大浪卷得无影无踪。修栈道的时候，士兵们要先小心翼翼地在悬崖上凿孔，然后插上木柱石柱，再架起横梁，最后铺上木板。
page_text_en: Above are sheer cliffs, below are surging waves. If a soldier slips and falls, he doesn't even have time to cry out "Help!" before being swept away by the waves and disappearing without a trace. When repairing the mountain path, soldiers must first carefully drill holes into the cliff face, then insert wooden and stone pillars, raise beams, and finally lay down wooden planks.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了士兵们在险峻的悬崖上修缮被烧毁的栈道的艰难场景，上方是峭壁，下方是汹涌波涛，稍有不慎便会坠入深渊，修路过程充满危险。

page_text_ocr_zh: 遇到山涧，士兵们就在水中的石头上穿孔，插木柱，架起一座桥来。有巨石挡路，士兵们就燃起熊熊的火堆，把石头烧得滚烫滚烫的；再担起河里的冷水，一桶一桶地泼上去。滚烫的石头一遇冷水就容易碎了，士兵们就这样用锤子砸出一条路来。可是这样下来，一天连五百米长的栈道都修不出来呀！
page_text_en: When encountering a ravine, the soldiers drilled holes in the rocks in the water, inserted wooden posts, and built a bridge. When huge rocks blocked the way, the soldiers lit fierce fires to heat the stones until they were scorching hot; then they carried cold water from the river and poured it bucket by bucket onto the hot stones. The hot stones cracked easily when hit by cold water, and the soldiers thus hammered out a path. But even with this method, they couldn't repair even 500 meters of the plank road in a single day!
summary_zh: 本页描绘了士兵们在险峻山涧中修缮栈道的艰难过程：他们用火烤石、冷水激裂的方法开路，但进展缓慢，一天连五百米都修不了。

page_text_ocr_zh: 韩信派人修栈道的消息很快传到了关中。关中的雍王章邯嘲笑说：“韩信要重修栈道，是想从南郑打过来呀！哈哈，看他猴年马月能修通！”不过，他还是派出重兵，严严实实地守住栈道的出口。就算汉军修通了栈道，韩信也休想打进关中来。
page_text_en: The news that Han Xin had sent men to repair the mountain path quickly reached Guanzhong. King Zhang Han of Yong laughed and said, “Han Xin wants to repair the mountain path — he must be planning to attack from Nanzheng! Haha, let’s see when he’ll finish it — maybe in the Year of the Monkey!” Nevertheless, he still sent a large force to tightly guard the exit of the path. Even if the Han army managed to repair the path, Han Xin would never be able to enter Guanzhong.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了雍王章邯得知韩信修缮栈道后，嘲笑其不可能成功，但仍派重兵严守栈道出口，以防汉军进攻。

page_text_ocr_zh: 谁知道，一个多月后的一天夜里，章邯正在呼呼大睡呢，突然被卫兵摇醒了："大王，韩信带兵袭击关中的陈仓了！""这怎么可能！栈道这么快就修好了？"章邯惊得从床上跳起来。
page_text_en: Who would have thought? One night, over a month later, Zhang Han was sound asleep when suddenly a guard shook him awake: "Your Majesty, Han Xin has led his troops to attack Chen Cang in Guanzhong!" "How is that possible? The mountain pass was repaired so quickly?" Zhang Han jumped out of bed in shock.
summary_zh: 章邯在睡梦中被卫兵惊醒，得知韩信已率军袭击陈仓，震惊于栈道被迅速修好，慌忙起身应对。

page_text_ocr_zh:
栈道当然没有这么快修好。那么，韩信是怎样从南郑来到陈仓的呢？

原来，韩信知道秦岭里还有一条小路能通到关中。他故意派人大张旗鼓地修栈道，吸引章邯的注意；自己和刘邦则悄悄地，带着十万大军，从小路穿过秦岭，如神兵天降般到了陈仓。

所以，像韩信这样先用声势浩大的行动来迷惑敌人，然后出奇制胜的计策，就叫“明修栈道，暗度陈仓”。
page_text_en:
The栈道 certainly couldn't be repaired that quickly. So, how did Han Xin get from Nanzheng to Chen Cang?

Originally, Han Xin knew there was a small path through the Qinling Mountains leading to Guanzhong. He deliberately sent troops to repair the栈道 in a grand and noisy manner to attract Zhang Han's attention; meanwhile, he and Liu Bang secretly, with a hundred thousand troops, crossed the Qinling Mountains via the hidden path, arriving at Chen Cang like divine soldiers descending from the sky.

Therefore, this strategy—using a grand, noisy action to deceive the enemy, then achieving victory through surprise—is called 'Repairing the栈道 in the Open, Crossing Chen Cang in Secret.'
summary_zh: 本页解释了韩信如何通过‘明修栈道，暗度陈仓’的计策，率军绕道秦岭小路，成功抵达陈仓，从而实现战略突袭。

page_text_ocr_zh:
章邯慌忙派兵支援陈仓，
可是他已经失去了反败为
胜的机会。
这时，汉军的其他将领也
带兵到达了关中，他们与
韩信分路进攻。正如韩信
所料，不到五个月，他们
就打败了关中的楚军，平
定了三秦。
page_text_en:
Zhang Han hurriedly sent troops to reinforce Chen Cang,
but he had already lost the chance to turn defeat into victory.
At this time, other Han generals also
arrived in Guanzhong with their troops, and they
advanced together with Han Xin. As Han Xin
had predicted, within less than five months, they
defeated the Chu forces in Guanzhong and
pacified the Three Qins.
summary_zh: 章邯派兵支援陈仓但已错过战机，汉军其他将领与韩信分路进攻，不到五个月便打败关中楚军，平定三秦。
